tests.reason: Untestable (no way): Cursor 3.32.4 on macOS runs the same generated extension and reports the VS Code 1.147.0 extension API (editor-activation.json in hosted run 45529254438), whose Terminal interface (src/vscode-dts/vscode.d.ts at tag 1.147.0) has no buffer, cell or link read; command output is plain text. Cursor is closed source, so its internals are unprobed; through the API it ships, no cell's link can be read. Its renderer link layer needs a non-default debug launch and its hover tooltip a pointer the owned-host no-input rule forbids. OSC 8 has no query form, and the plain probe only reads the cursor, which cannot verify link metadata. This records the observation surface, not whether the app stores the link.
